d:
Official video for the original single "Home" by Vidya Vox, from Kuthu Fire EP:
Hey guys! Been a while... This song is off my EP "Kuthu Fire." Shankar and I wrote tune on one of those days we were feeling particularly homesick. This is so special to me, because home to me is when my family & friends are with me. One of my best friends, Sangeeta, who I have known since we were 10, flew to LA to dance in the video. She brought a part of my home to the video and I couldn't be more thankful.
